globalChanges: Replaced distant or conspicuously false alternatives with closer developmental-domain, signaling, chronology, causal-inference, and phenotype competitors where needed.
Recalibrated 14 originally difficulty-4 items to difficulty 3; current knowledge tags match difficulty >= 4.
Replaced pending-review metadata with independent-review-complete language while keeping every question draft.
Source-qualified the amyoplasia concept and clarified item 037's limb-muscle structural-versus-functional distinction.
No source locators or scientific answer keys required correction; no module or objective-ID remapping was required.

existingQuestionsRead.objective: Separate the loss of growth-plate lengthening from surviving surface growth and remodeling.
Distinguish dorsal plexus divisions of ventral rami from dorsal primary rami.
Discriminate HOXA13-associated hand-foot-genital findings from HOXD13 synpolydactyly.
Separate mesenchymal FGF10 initiation from established-ridge FGF4/8 maintenance.
Distinguish movement-related fetal contracture from deletion or duplication of limb elements.
Differentiate lateral-plate and somite contributions to the developing limb.
Predict proximodistal truncation from the timing of AER loss.
Integrate AER-FGF withdrawal, retinoic acid, and segment-specific markers.
Distinguish AER subdivision from interdigital apoptosis in digit formation.
Use embryonic limb rotations to explain adult compartment and digit orientation.
Trace the synovial-joint interzone into its major derivatives.
Identify the cited inductive signal for joint-interzone formation while preserving source uncertainty.
Separate muscle-cell origin from connective-tissue control of limb muscle pattern.
Apply TBX5 versus TBX4-PITX1 to limb-type specification.
Predict the digit pattern produced by ectopic anterior SHH.
Trace EN1, WNT7a, and LMX1 in dorsoventral limb patterning.
Integrate AER-FGF, ZPA-SHH, and dorsal WNT7a feedback.

retainedRelatedPairs.reason: 009 is the SER2/AER location at the RFNG expression interface; 014 is EN1 repression creating that interface; the existing item is EN1 restriction of WNT7a. Related successive steps, not renamed copies. Both new boundary items are difficulty 3.
Functional requirement for innervation and mixed segmental cell contribution are distinct from connective-tissue control of muscle pattern.
Axial field position and limits of a PITX1 clinical association are distinct from the forelimb/hindlimb identity-switch experiment.
Normal terminal differentiation and nonunique causes of transverse morphology differ from the known timing of experimental ridge removal.

residualLimitations: Dedicated primary limb-embryology slides, lecturer notes, recordings, and exam weighting remain unavailable; comprehensive textbook extension is not complete course recovery.
Selected developmental models are attributed to the inspected 15th-edition Langman account; they are not a claim of current research consensus beyond that source.
The general notes' varicella-associated limb hypoplasia row was not expanded without primary-source inspection.
Historical author self-audit files retain the pre-review snapshot; independent_validate.cjs and this report cover current signed payload.
